about: The biggest names in dance music from the underground to the arena.

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 21 Jan. Effy spotlights the places she calls home with a celebration of the electronic sounds coming from the north of England, Scotland, Wales and Ireland. Expect music from the likes of Overmono, Kelly Lee Owens, Daithi and more. Plus Effy closes her Residency with two high energy mixes in her signature sound. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Effy - Northern English and Celtic Culture

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 14 Jan. Effy celebrates up and coming producers as well as favourites who are already smashing it! With music selections from talent across the globe, expect tracks from David Jackson, Jun Kamoda, Ross from Friends and more. Plus rising star from Sydney, Attu, provides a high energy guest mix spinning her club ready selections. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Effy - Up and coming

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 7 Jan. Effy takes us on a journey around the world with music from her favourite producers and DJs. Expect music from Australia, Ireland, Japan and beyond! Plus, French DJ Vitaline is in the mix, with her signature sound that fuses bass, techno and breaks. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Effy - Around the World

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 31 Dec. Effy steps up to the Residency hot seat with an introduction to her sound! Expect emotional electronic music, nostalgic EDM and deep house sounds with tracks from Dusky, Maya Jane Coles, Bicep and more. Plus, Effy invites French producer RONI into the CLUBGRL Mix to spin 30 minutes of music from the likes of Saidah, Ploy, I. JORDAN and more. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Effy - Nostalgia

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 24 Dec. Legend of the dance music scene, Jamie Jones, takes over the Residency for one night only, sharing loads of his favourite tracks and even some very special exclusive IDs. He also jumps in the mix exploring groovy house sounds. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: One night with Jamie Jones

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 17 Dec. Sam Alfred brings the heat for his final Residency show packed full of peak time energy! Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - Peak Time

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 10 Dec. Discover sounds from down under as Sam Alfred shares his favourite Aussie producers in a show all about the Australian Dance Music scene. Expect music from Confidence Man, HAAi, Mall Grab and more. Sam jumps in the mix spinning tracks to showcase the pool of talent from his home country, with music from Marli, CC Disco and more. And Australian podcaster and DJ Ricky Nord provides the guest mix with 30 minutes of Aussie selections. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - Australian dance music

items.desc: On BBC Sounds until 3 Dec. Expect a deeper more melodic side to Sam Alfred over the next two hours as he explores the art of the opening set with deep house and minimal sounds. With tracks from Leo Pol, Nathan Coles, Youandewan and more. Plus Sam jumps in the mix to showcase his approach to an opening set, with music from Maya Jane Coles, Robin Graham and Eden Burns. Produced by We Are Grape for BBC Radio 1 Dance.
items.title: Sam Alfred - The art of the opening set

name: The Residency on Radio 1 Dance
